messages:
anika: We've repeatedly seen a quick-fail pattern in recent postmortems: cache eviction bursts -> token-service P95 jump -> autoscaler oscillation. Opening a single-thread to lock in a compact runbook update, owners, and short remediation checklist.

peter: Love the idea. Keep the runbook edit minimal: one-line 'first responder' + exact commands + escalation matrix. We don't need long narrative.

jo: I'll take the runbook PR. I'll split it into: Quick Triage (one line), Immediate Mitigations (copy/paste cmds), Escalation (who to page & when), and Post-incident tasks. Assigning ticket RW-5233 to myself. Target PR by 2026-06-01.

sasha: Adding the operator commands we used in the last incident so on-call can copy/paste: 
```
# check eviction + p95
curl -fsS "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_eviction_rate[1m]"
curl -fsS "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=token_latency_p95"
# quick mitigation: lower batch on pool 'serve-fast'
redwoodctl deploy --pool serve-fast --set batch_size=4 --note "temp-mitigation-RW-5233"
# pin routing to low-mem variant for 15m
redwoodctl route set --model core-model --variant lowmem-1 --duration 15m --note "postmortem-RW-5233"
# safe rollback if needed
redwoodctl rollout rollback --model core-model --to-version stable
```

anika: Proposed Quick Triage one-liner at top of runbook: "1) check eviction + latency; 2) apply quick mitigations (batch/variant); 3) notify owners; 4) page if thresholds hit."

peter: Suggested thresholds for escalation: eviction_rate > 2% for 3m = notify Slack channel; eviction_rate > 5% for 5m OR token_p95 > 1s = page eng-oncall; sustained autoscaler oscillation = escalate to infra lead and open major incident.

jo: I'll include an owner matrix: who can pin variants (Platform SRE), who adjusts routing (Edge team), who modifies pool config (Infra). Also adding a post-change verification step: check eviction_down AND hit_ratio_up within 10m.

metrics-bot: MetricsBot: draft alert rule for `kv_cache_eviction_rate` and `token_latency_p95` created; suppression window = 3m to reduce flapping.

sasha: Small ops note for the runbook: always annotate temporary changes with `postmortem-<ticket>` and set an explicit duration so automation can auto-revert.

anika: Action items recap:
- jo: runbook + PR (RW-5233) 4  due 2026-06-01
- sasha: add ops snippets to ops-docs and examples 4 due EOD today
- peter: draft alert thresholds and link dashboards 4 due 48h
- metrics-bot: finalize composite alert & suppression 4 ETA 72h

peter: Let's schedule a 30-min tabletop with oncall after the PR merges to exercise the Quick Triage flow. I'll create a calendar invite for next week.

anika: Thanks all. If RW-5233 hits blockers, tag infra-eng-lead and we'll escalate. Closing this thread unless new blockers surface. :white_check_mark:
